name: 4blocks
description:
4BlocksRP is a German-speaking city roleplay server, and Bedrock players are welcome. Join from phone, tablet or console and play together with Java players in the same city.

Arrive in the city with nothing and work your way up. Take a job, earn your first money, buy a car and rent your own apartment. Join the police, the medics or a gang, or build up your own business. Everything runs through your in-game phone, so there are no chat commands to learn.

It is worth putting your time in here: server costs are paid a full year in advance and a team of 10 people works on the network.

What you get: jobs and factions, cars, housing, a real economy, an in-game phone, voice chat and a friends list. The server language is German.

How to join: add the server 4blocks.gg with port 19132. Free to play, no application, no pay-to-win. Servers are in the EU.

On PC there is even more: the free 4Blocks Launcher at 4blocks.gg also opens our MMORPG Heroes and seven more game modes.

Discord: discord.gg/4blocks
